baseline.equivalence_test: Frozen baseline generation, retrieval, QORE K=5 selection, evaluator, and model identity remain unchanged; the new runner records baseline before any ranker action.

core_invariants: Wiki-DPR retrieval and QORE selection execute exactly once per question with the Phase 9J frozen configuration.
Applicability uses only question, selected passages, generated candidate strings, DPR reader scores, and deterministic token-span matching.
Gold answers, labels, evaluator outputs, and retrieval-hit signals are unavailable until after candidate choice.
The diagnostic never mutates select_passages, Generator, evaluator, or production answer behavior.
Compact artifacts contain scalar metrics and stable mode IDs only; no raw question, passage, candidate, prompt, or prediction text is persisted.

interfaces.input_schema: candidate mode IDs, candidate strings, reader support scores, exact-span booleans
interfaces.output_schema: apply boolean, reason code, chosen mode, scalar reader margin, scalar scores
invariants: No gold-derived value is accepted as input

interfaces.input_schema: candidate mode IDs and DPR reader support scores
interfaces.output_schema: stable reader-span choice and reversed-order audit choice
invariants: Candidate mode IDs, not list positions, determine ranking

plugins.insertion_point: post frozen generator, pre post-hoc evaluation
plugins.hypothesis: The existing baseline remains the no-intervention comparator.
plugins.output_schema: baseline answer in memory plus compact scalar evaluation
failure_signatures: changed retrieval or QORE call count

plugins.insertion_point: post baseline generation, pre reader scoring
plugins.hypothesis: A fixed candidate set can be built without labels for every question.
plugins.output_schema: up to three candidate mode IDs and in-memory strings
plugins.resource_estimate: two additional frozen generations per question

plugins.insertion_point: post candidate generation, gated terminal answer choice
plugins.hypothesis: DPR reader span support identifies a better candidate when a context-exact span exists.
plugins.output_schema: candidate mode choice and scalar reader score audit
plugins.resource_estimate: one batched DPR reader forward pass per question with >=2 candidates

plugins.insertion_point: between reader scoring and terminal answer evaluation
plugins.hypothesis: Candidate diversity, non-baseline reader choice, exact span support, and nonnegative reader margin predict when the reader ranker should act.
plugins.input_schema: candidate count, unique count, reader scores, exact-span booleans
plugins.output_schema: apply boolean, frozen reason code, scalar applicability trace

plugins.hypothesis: Stable candidate IDs make the policy invariant to candidate list order.
plugins.input_schema: original and reversed candidate mode lists

composition.merge_rule: The gate may either keep the baseline or select the reader-ranked candidate; post-hoc evaluator output is never fed backward.
interaction_ablations: gold-free gate with reversed candidate order

validation.baseline_equivalence: Compare baseline scalar outputs and generation calls against the frozen Phase 9J runner on a synthetic fixture; no production code path is imported for mutation.
tests: synthetic applicability gate accepts a supported non-baseline exact span
synthetic gate rejects a non-exact top candidate
candidate order replay returns the same mode choice
compact schema rejects forbidden raw fields
all-question paired metric summary applies baseline on non-applied rows

reproducibility.environment: Auto-resolved compatible Python; pinned NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct revision 53346005fb0ef11d3b6a83b12c895cca40156b6c; resolved model path and config hash in manifest

limitations: The applicability thresholds are a fixed heuristic, not a learned calibrated probability.
The first screen is report-only and cannot authorize a production selector change; total pipeline cost includes both candidate generations and reader scoring.
The candidate generation and reader scoring ideas have high collision risk with ordinary answer reranking literature.
A positive all-question gate would still require an independent replication before any production consideration.
